active.title: Signal at Pier 9
active.summary: The Aerie's sensors picked up a spike of unlicensed bio-energy from a disused warehouse at Pier 9, right when break-ins and muggings started climbing in the dockside blocks around it. Sable wants eyes on the warehouse and the spike identified before it becomes the city's problem.
objectives: Reach Pier 9 and get eyes inside the warehouse
Identify the source of the energy spike
active.obstacles: A small hired crew is squatting in the warehouse (reskin any team from roster/strike/villains/ — the AXEMen or U-Men both scale to a first outing).
active.secret_truth: The crew stole an experimental power-suppression rig from a defunct research lab and are trying to fence it, with no idea what it does. If it's triggered near an active power, it dampens it for the scene — a nasty surprise mid-fight, and a live wire once the party realizes it can be turned on either side.
active.rewards: The Aerie's gratitude, a favor banked with city PD, first claim on the suppression rig (keep it, study it, or hand it off — GM's call what that unlocks)
